title: Joe Jonas sends fans wild with his cowboy 'glow up' on The Burning Up: All Over Again tour
text:
Joe Jonas has sent his fans wild with his cowboy 'glow up' as he takes to the stage with the Jonas Brothers on The Burning Up: All Over Again tour. The singer, 37, has been winning the hearts of fans across the globe since he started his career 20 years ago alongside his brothers Nick, 33, and Kevin, 38.

The singer, 37, has been winning the hearts of fans across the globe since he started his career 20 years ago alongside his brothers Nick, 33, and Kevin, 38. But his recent look has got them burnin' up as he took to the stage on tour to sing their famous track, wearing a tank top and cowboy hat.
Joe's top revealed his muscular and tattooed arms, which he wore with a pair of light rinse denim jeans with a brown belt. Joe and his brothers are on the road again on a North American tour and fans have claimed the middle Jonas is looking better than ever. Videos of the band - particularly Joe - have been circulating online since the band's tour kicked off, with fans going wild for his new cowboy look.

The singer, 37, has been winning the hearts of fans across the globe since he started his career 20 years ago alongside his brothers Nick, 33, and Kevin, 38. Joe has undergone a massive style evolution from his Disney Channel purity-ring era to a mature, high-fashion pop icon.
Joe, who appeared in the Disney Camp Rock films with his brothers, initially sported straight-ironed side-swept bangs and a moodier teen-pop aesthetic. After years with the Jonas Brothers, Joe broke out with his own band DNCE where he opted for bleached hair, retro prints and relaxed streetwear. But later returning to where he began, Joe opts for both high fashion looks off stage and more tailored and form-fitting looks while performing.
Joe's new look has also been referred to as his 'divorce glow up', after splitting from his ex-wife Sophie Turner in August 2023. The couple were married for four years after tying the knot in May 2019 and welcomed two daughters, Willa, six, and Delphine, four. Joe recently made rare remarks about being a 'single dad' and co-parenting two daughters with his ex-wife.

Joe recently made rare remarks about being a 'single dad' and co-parenting two daughters with his ex-wife Sophie Turner. The ex couple - who briefly battled over custody of their girls - had their divorce finalised in 2024.
Joe was responding to a caller's question about 'the most healing part of being a parent' during his brothers' Hey Jonas podcast.
'I'm a single dad and I co-parent with my children's mother,' the globetrotting boybander said. 'I think my children have given me, like, purpose again in my life. ' He went on to explain that he feels even more 'grateful' for 'my shared time where I get to be with them' and 'it makes it so much better to work that much harder'. 'They've really given me the reason to be alive,' the former Disney Channel star said.
'I think, in my saddest moments, I'm able to be reminded quickly that a hug from them can solve the world's problems, in my own world. And I know I'm not hyper unique.
'There's a lot of people in my situation that are single parents and go through this, and I'm grateful that I have a co-parent that I can balance even the bad days. ' Joe noted that it's 'really special' to have 'good people around me to kind of help me navigate it' and teach him 'that I'll be okay even in my toughest days'. 'I think we're doing the best we can,' Sophie told British Vogue in 2024.

Joe is now in a relationship with Puerto Rican model Tatiana Gabriela, who's best known for appearing in Bad Bunny's 2025 music video for BAILE INoLVIDABLE. According to DeuxMoi, the coy couple have been going strong ever since their first sighting at Maru Café in LA in late September.
Joe previously dated Stormi Bree, Daiane Sodré, Gigi Hadid, Liraz Dror, Blanda Eggenschwiler, Ashley Greene, Demi Lovato, Camilla Belle and Taylor Swift. The Jonas Brothers are next scheduled to perform on August 20 in New York.
